findings.note: README says the export job at src/pay/exporter.py was removed in 0.1.0, but a functionally equivalent module (legacy_export.py, export_v1) still ships in src/pay under a different name; the named path never existed and the job it describes was not actually removed.

findings.note: refund.py has no argparse, no __main__ guard, and no console_scripts entry point anywhere in the repo (pyproject.toml, setup.py); `python -m pay.refund --help` as documented would import the module and exit with no help output rather than showing usage.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: Flagged as stale, but content is a one-line placeholder with no technical claims about code, so there is nothing for the code to contradict.
Flagged as stale, but the described design (JSON-lines append-only ledger, reversals as new entries) matches src/pay/ledger.py's current implementation.

not_assessed: CHANGELOG.md / README.md 'days behind code' staleness figures given in the leads are taken as given signals, not independently recomputed from commit timestamps
